description: Benchmark evaluation suite for component-authoring skill following agentskills.io specifications

cases.description: Scaffold SkillBadge component with ReadonlyDeep props and barrel export registered in TypeDoc
cases.prompt: Create a new SkillBadge component under src/components/SkillBadge with colocation, BEM SCSS, ReadonlyDeep props and TypeDoc registration in docs/astro.config.ts.

assertions.description: Component file exists in colocated directory
Uses ReadonlyDeep props wrapper without unnecessary ReadonlyExcept
Registered in Starlight TypeDoc entry points

cases.description: Component with forwardable ref correctly using ReadonlyExcept for ref prop
cases.prompt: Author a custom Button component that accepts a React 19 standard ref and applies ReadonlyExcept.

assertions.description: Uses ReadonlyExcept strictly to except the ref prop
Does not use deprecated React 19 forwardRef

cases.description: Enforce event parameter naming convention e and RefObject types
cases.prompt: Refactor JobItem component to adhere to React 19 event naming standards and ref typing.

assertions.description: Event handler parameters must be named e, never event

cases.description: Implement component-scoped BEM SCSS with container query context
cases.prompt: Author ProjectCard.scss with BEM naming and container-type inline-size declaration.

assertions.description: Declares container-type inline-size on root element
